items.title: Sandstorm theme
items.description: A warm desert theme (day + night) added next to your themes.
items.prompt: Add the theme in files/sandstorm.css to the app layer: append it to custom.css (or a themes/ file imported from it) and register {"id":"sandstorm","name":"Sandstorm"} in themes.json. Keep any existing entries.

items.title: Focus timer view
items.description: A small Pomodoro-style focus view in the sidebar.
items.prompt: Copy files/focus.js into the app layer's plugins/ folder (rename if a plugin with that name exists).
